subject.title: Separate the scalable usage dashboard from the social share artifact

question: Should CodexBar sponsor the proposed scalable Usage & Spend exploration surface beyond the already merged dashboard and fixed-size local share artifact?
rationale: The request defines a new information architecture and UI-proof matrix, so source inspection cannot determine the intended permanent product boundary or acceptable scope.

options.title: Sponsor a scoped dashboard follow-up
options.body: Approve a focused design/implementation plan that preserves the existing local, provider-specific usage and share-card contracts.

options.title: Defer the expanded dashboard
options.body: Keep the shipped dashboard and share card as the supported surface until a later product cycle prioritizes scalable exploration.

options.title: Limit work to correctness fixes
options.body: Retain the tracker only for the linked production hardening items and decline new dashboard information-architecture scope for now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a scoped dashboard follow-up
recommendation.body: Approve a focused design/implementation plan that preserves the existing local, provider-specific usage and share-card contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository-level product direction is required to choose the permanent UI boundary.
